financial_model._opex_note: ≈ $3,735/mo non-draw OpEx (S&M, legal, insurance, G&A, travel, infra) from PROJECTIONS Year-1 + COSTS. Founder draw is NOT here — it is ARR-gated in founder_compensation below.

founder_compensation._note: Founder draws $0 until ARR >= 3× base ($255K). Then salary steps up at ARR milestones (concave / non-linear — ARR can grow 30x while salary ~2x). Each month, (salary − lifestyle) accumulates toward the LIQUID millionaire index — the slow organic path, distinct from an exit. While not drawing, salary contributes $0 to liquid. tax_rate 0 = literal salary − lifestyle; raise it to model take-home. ARR here = recurring MRR × 12.

valuation._note: Enterprise value implied by recurring revenue (ARR × multiple). PROJECTIONS.md uses 5-8× ARR for mid-market vertical SaaS; 6× is the mid. The company's MARKED valuation each period = max(ARR × this multiple, latest round post-money, standing acquisition offer, asserted mark). This is what makes revenue create growth potential continuously, not only at a priced event.

raise._note: INVESTMENT TRACK — staged, concurrent with revenue & acquisition. A stage closes when committed-indicative interest >= min_viable AND ARR >= that stage's arr_floor; proceeds = min(committed, stage max_size) at pre = max(stage pre_money, ARR×valuation.arr_multiple); it dilutes the founder, injects cash, marks the round post-money, and the next stage becomes available. Caps prevent hallucinated mega-rounds. close_lag_months delays the wire.

founder_millionaire_index.paper_basis: founder_ownership_pct × marked valuation (priced round pre-money or acquisition price). ILLIQUID.
founder_millionaire_index.liquid_basis: actual founder cash: acquisition cash-out (ownership × price × cash portion) + any founder secondary (+ salary only if count_salary_toward_liquid). A priced fundraise does NOT count — proceeds go to the company treasury, not the founder.
founder_millionaire_index.liquid_paths_note: Liquid net worth accrues three ways: (1) acquisition cash-out, (2) founder secondary in a round, (3) the SLOW organic path — (salary − lifestyle) per month, governed by founder_compensation. A priced fundraise alone does NOT make the founder liquid.
founder_millionaire_index._note: Pre-revenue, no prior priced round → NOT a paper millionaire at t0, and $0 liquid. A priced raise marks PAPER (founder ~$3.5-4M on close) but yields ~$0 LIQUID. In a 6-month RAISE scenario expect paper = raise-close month; liquid stays ~null because the founder isn't even drawing salary yet (ARR << $255K) and there's no exit. The salary−lifestyle path is a multi-year climb.
